mentions.note: beaten by John Bicourt by 6 yds

mentions.h: JULY 21st 1976 - BATTERSEA PARK - INTER-CLUB v HERCULES WIMB. AC, L.A.C.

photos.c: The water-jump with one lap to go in the Southern Champs. 3000m Steeplechase. JOHN BICOURT (top) leads Lightfoot (Devonport) and goes on to beat the Devon man by 6 yds, finishing 2nd in 9:05.8
